sentences.en: As the Trump administration clamps down on immigration, asylum seekers fleeing to Canada are discovering that it's not quite the promised land some had hoped for.
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普政府收紧移民政策，逃往加拿大的寻求庇护者发现，那里并不完全是他们所希望的应许之地。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月29日，星期一。

sentences.en: And this breaking news from the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 以下是来自国土安全部的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Breaking news that has to do with immigration right now.
sentences.zh: 关于移民的突发新闻。

sentences.en: We're just learning that moments ago, the Department of Homeland Security said it will end.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚获悉，就在片刻前，国土安全部宣布将终止。

sentences.en: Decided to end.
sentences.zh: 决定终止。

sentences.en: Is ending.
sentences.zh: 正在终止。

sentences.en: The temporary protected status.
sentences.zh: 临时保护身份（TPS）。

sentences.en: It's TPS that allowed nearly 60,000 Haitians to live in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正是这项TPS政策，让近6万名海地人得以在美国生活。

sentences.en: since the 2010 quake.
sentences.zh: 自2010年地震以来。

sentences.en: 200,000 Salvadorians, many who have lived in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 20万萨尔瓦多人，其中许多人自2001年起就住在美国，

sentences.en: since 2001, are being told that they have to leave the country by September 2019 or be deported.
sentences.zh: 现在被告知必须在2019年9月前离开美国，否则将被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: I lost my house in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 我在海地失去了房子。

sentences.en: 2010, I lost my house.
sentences.zh: 2010年，我失去了房子。

sentences.en: I don't have nothing in Haiti.
sentences.zh: 我在海地一无所有。

sentences.en: When I go to Haiti, I don't have a place to stay in my two children born here.
sentences.zh: 如果回海地，我在那里没有住处，而我的两个孩子是在这里出生的。

sentences.en: It's a nightmare for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: What does it mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: To us, it means that our sense of protection, our sense of security, all of that is going to vanish.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这意味着我们的保护感、安全感，这一切都将烟消云散。

sentences.en: When President Trump signaled that migrant groups, including Haitians and El Salvadorans, would be losing their temporary protected status,
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统发出信号，称包括海地人和萨尔瓦多人在内的移民群体将失去临时保护身份时，

sentences.en: all of a sudden, thousands of migrants started pouring across the border from the United States into Canada.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，成千上万的移民开始从美国涌入加拿大边境。

sentences.en: Under the threat of the temporary protected status being lifted, they are afraid of getting deported from the United States
sentences.zh: 在临时保护身份即将被取消的威胁下，他们害怕被从美国驱逐出境，

sentences.en: and think they have a better shot of getting asylum if they cross the border into Canada.
sentences.zh: 并认为如果越境进入加拿大，他们获得庇护的机会更大。

sentences.en: Dan Belewski reports for The Times from Montreal.
sentences.zh: 丹·贝列夫斯基为《纽约时报》从蒙特利尔发回报道。

sentences.en: Most of the migrants I spoke to told me that they had left their homes in the United States, whether in New York or elsewhere,
sentences.zh: 我采访的大多数移民都告诉我，他们离开了在美国的家，无论是在纽约还是其他地方，

sentences.en: essentially boarded a Greyhound bus to Plattsburgh in New York State.
sentences.zh: 基本上是坐灰狗巴士到了纽约州的普拉茨堡。

sentences.en: And from there, they take a taxi to an irregular, unofficial part of the border to try and circumvent an agreement between the United States and Canada,
sentences.zh: 然后从那里，他们打车前往边境一个非正规、非官方的地点，试图规避美国和加拿大之间的一项协议，

sentences.en: which requires migrants to apply for asylum in the country where they first arrived, in this case, the United States.
sentences.zh: 该协议要求移民必须在他们首先抵达的国家（本案中即美国）申请庇护。

sentences.en: However, if the migrants enter at an unofficial part of the border, this creates a loophole that then allows them to apply for asylum in Canada.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果移民从边境的非官方地点进入，就会产生一个漏洞，从而允许他们在加拿大申请庇护。

sentences.en: And it sounds like this is something that's understood by both officials on the border and the migrants trying to cross it.
sentences.zh: 听起来边境官员和试图越境的移民双方都明白这一点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Many of the migrants told me that when they arrived, they were only too delighted to be arrested by a friendly Canadian Mountie or Royal Canadian Mounted Police.
sentences.zh: 许多移民告诉我，当他们到达时，非常乐意被友好的加拿大皇家骑警逮捕。

sentences.en: Are you from Haiti?
sentences.zh: 你们来自海地吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Are the kids American citizens?
sentences.zh: 孩子们是美国公民吗？

sentences.en: It's not like the Mexican border where you can imagine trying to breach a wall.
sentences.zh: 这不像墨西哥边境，你可能会想象去翻越一堵墙。

sentences.en: The Canadians recognizing that all these people are coming have actually established an informal greeting process.
sentences.zh: 加拿大人意识到所有这些人都在涌入，实际上已经建立了一个非正式的接待流程。

sentences.en: This is an illegal point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非法入境点。

sentences.en: This is not a way to come in.
sentences.zh: 这不是入境的途径。

sentences.en: Yes, we know.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们知道。

sentences.en: Does anybody have a valid visa currently for the United States?
sentences.zh: 目前有人持有有效的美国签证吗？

sentences.en: Even if it expires soon?
sentences.zh: 即使很快就要过期？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Are you aware that the very minute you cross this border, your status in the United States is nullified?
sentences.zh: 你们是否意识到，一旦越过这条边境，你们在美国的身份就作废了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it's sort of like wink-wink, nudge-nudge system that has been created by which they end up being screened and fingerprinted, asked how much money they have,
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一种心照不宣的系统，他们最终会被筛查、采集指纹、询问身上带了多少钱，

sentences.en: and kind of whisked across the border, in some cases, with their families.
sentences.zh: 然后被带过边境，在某些情况下，是带着家人一起。

sentences.en: Do you have any questions for me?
sentences.zh: 你们有什么问题要问我吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: We just want to come in.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想进去。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: For the fact that we believe in Canada, that Canada can solve our problem, that's why we are here.
sentences.zh: 因为我们相信加拿大，相信加拿大能解决我们的问题，所以我们才来到这里。

sentences.en: We are saving Canada.
sentences.zh: 我们在拯救加拿大。

sentences.en: And we don't have any other choice to go back.
sentences.zh: 我们别无选择，不能回去。

sentences.en: We don't have any other place to go back.
sentences.zh: 我们没有其他地方可去。

sentences.en: Our mind is made up.
sentences.zh: 我们已经下定决心了。

sentences.en: We want to come into Canada.
sentences.zh: 我们要进入加拿大。

sentences.en: We don't have any other choice to go back.
sentences.zh: 我们别无选择，不能回去。

sentences.en: We don't have any other choice to go back.
sentences.zh: 我们别无选择，不能回去。

sentences.en: And Dan, what happens once the migrants get past the border and into Canada?
sentences.zh: 丹，移民越过边境进入加拿大后会发生什么？

sentences.en: So once they're screened and fingerprinted and get into Canada, some of them end up at migrant centres, and in many cases they team up with another migrant
sentences.zh: 一旦他们被筛查、采集指纹并进入加拿大，有些人会被安置在移民中心，在许多情况下，他们会与其他移民结伴，

sentences.en: to rent a low-cost apartment.
sentences.zh: 租一套低价公寓。

sentences.en: And when they apply for asylum and are waiting for an answer, they are given a work permit, so they can work almost immediately, a monthly stipend of about $500 U.S.,
sentences.zh: 当他们申请庇护并等待结果时，会获得工作许可，几乎可以立即工作，每月还能领到约500美元的津贴，

sentences.en: free health care, and even free French lessons.
sentences.zh: 免费医疗，甚至免费的法语课程。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So there's an immediate attempt to set these migrants up, give them shelter, give them an opportunity to work, and I guess with the language skills, to assimilate all the resources
sentences.zh: 所以，他们会立即尝试安置这些移民，提供住所，提供工作机会，我想通过语言技能，整合所有资源，

sentences.en: that they would need to basically start a new life in Canada.
sentences.zh: 让他们基本上能在加拿大开始新生活。

sentences.en: Yes, a new life.
sentences.zh: 是的，新生活。

sentences.en: Diversity is its indispensable ingredient.
sentences.zh: 多元化是其不可或缺的要素。

sentences.en: I think when people think of Canada, they think of this kumbaya liberal paradise, this multicultural place that welcomes and embraces diversity and immigration,
sentences.zh: 我想当人们想到加拿大时，会想到这是一个自由主义的乌托邦，一个欢迎并拥抱多元化和移民的多元文化之地，

sentences.en: and this has become all the more pronounced as Canada has presented itself as a liberal counterpoint to the United States of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 随着加拿大将自己呈现为特朗普总统治下美国的自由主义对立面，这一点变得更加突出。

sentences.en: Now, many of you have reached out to me recently in thanks for Canada's compassionate response to the Syrian refugee crisis.
sentences.zh: 最近，你们许多人联系我，感谢加拿大对叙利亚难民危机的同情回应。

sentences.en: The idealized image of a welcoming country was reinforced by Justin Trudeau, the Canadian prime minister, who in January of last year tweeted that those fleeing war and persecution
sentences.zh: 这种受欢迎国家的理想形象得到了加拿大总理贾斯汀·特鲁多的强化，他在去年1月发推文称，那些逃离战争和迫害的人

sentences.en: would be welcoming Canada, and that came just days after Trump temporarily barred travelers from seven majority Muslim countries.
sentences.zh: 将受到加拿大的欢迎，而这距离特朗普暂时禁止七个穆斯林占多数国家的旅客入境仅过了几天。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Pleasure to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Oh, listen, it's our pleasure.
sentences.zh: 哦，听着，这是我们的荣幸。

sentences.en: We're very happy.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴。

sentences.en: We are very happy.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴。

sentences.en: Welcome to your new home.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到你们的新家。

sentences.en: Let me tell you something.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你一件事。

sentences.en: When I welcomed those first families to Toronto last month, I welcomed them as new Canadians and as the future of the Canadian economy.
sentences.zh: 上个月我欢迎那些第一批家庭来到多伦多时，我欢迎他们成为新加拿大人，成为加拿大经济的未来。

sentences.en: I remember Trudeau at the airport greeting those Syrian refugees flying, and I remember actually, I think the Canadian government even packaged a video
sentences.zh: 我记得特鲁多在机场迎接那些乘机而来的叙利亚难民，我记得，我想加拿大政府甚至制作了一个视频，

sentences.en: that was beautifully produced and suggested, you know, just how welcoming the country was.
sentences.zh: 制作得非常精美，暗示了这个国家是多么受欢迎。

sentences.en: It was a very moving set of images.
sentences.zh: 那是一组非常感人的画面。

sentences.en: No, it was.
sentences.zh: 不，确实如此。

sentences.en: And indeed, Justin Trudeau has self-consciously presented himself as a liberal progressive alternative to President Trump and the president's United States
sentences.zh: 事实上，贾斯汀·特鲁多确实自觉地将自己呈现为特朗普总统及其治下美国的自由进步派替代者，

sentences.en: on everything from immigration to healthcare.
sentences.zh: 从移民到医疗保健，方方面面皆是如此。

sentences.en: And as a result, I think immigrants the world over and in the United States see him as some sort of benevolent, welcoming figure.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为全世界和美国的移民都将他视为某种仁慈、受欢迎的人物。

sentences.en: And the result is that thousands of migrants have been heading to Canada.
sentences.zh: 结果就是成千上万的移民开始涌向加拿大。

sentences.en: I found that Canada is, was the best option for me and my family.
sentences.zh: 我发现加拿大是我和家人的最佳选择。

sentences.en: You guys understand humanitarian.
sentences.zh: 你们懂得人道主义。

sentences.en: Unlike in the United States, you treat people as human beings.
sentences.zh: 不像在美国，你们把人当作人来对待。

sentences.en: I went to search Google and I figured out this is what everybody's doing, that Canada has a future for the children, for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我上网查了一下，发现每个人都在这样做，加拿大对孩子们、对每个人都有未来。

sentences.en: So that's why I want to give it a chance.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我想尝试一下的原因。

sentences.en: It's a risk.
sentences.zh: 这是一种冒险。

sentences.en: I understand that.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: I want to take the risk because I know there's a future here for me and the baby.
sentences.zh: 我想冒险，因为我知道这里有我和孩子的未来。

sentences.en: Why don't you stay in the United States?
sentences.zh: 为什么不留在美国？

sentences.en: Because Donald Trump don't want me to stay in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因为唐纳德·特朗普不想让我留在美国。

sentences.en: But I don't care because I believe Canada has better offer than the United States can offer me.
sentences.zh: 但我不在乎，因为我相信加拿大能提供比美国更好的条件。

sentences.en: Do you think Canada will let you stay?
sentences.zh: 你认为加拿大让你留下吗？

sentences.en: Yes, they will let me stay.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们会让我留下的。

sentences.en: Why do you think that?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么认为？

sentences.en: Because I'm not going back.
sentences.zh: 因为我不会回去。

sentences.en: They don't have a choice then to let me stay.
sentences.zh: 他们到时候别无选择，只能让我留下。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that's not actually true.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Many of them will not get to stay.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人将无法留下。

sentences.en: Many of the migrants who are streaming into Canada and requesting asylum don't qualify for asylum.
sentences.zh: 许多涌入加拿大并寻求庇护的移民并不符合庇护条件。

sentences.en: And once judges adjudicate over the viability of their claims, if they don't qualify for asylum, they will be deported back to their country of origin,
sentences.zh: 一旦法官裁定他们的申请是否成立，如果他们不符合庇护条件，他们将被驱逐回原籍国，

sentences.en: which in the case of many is Haiti.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，那就是海地。

sentences.en: So people who are leaving
sentences.zh: 所以，那些离开

sentences.en: Trump's America for Canada are playing a game of Russian roulette in the sense that if they get deported from Canada, they will not get sent back to the United States
sentences.zh: 特朗普治下的美国前往加拿大的人，是在玩俄罗斯轮盘赌，因为如果他们被加拿大驱逐，他们不会被送回美国，

sentences.en: or to their homes in New York State.
sentences.zh: 也不会被送回他们在纽约州的家。

sentences.en: They will be sent back to Haiti.
sentences.zh: 他们会被送回海地。

sentences.en: And their situations could be far worse than if they would have just stayed in the United States to begin with.
sentences.zh: 他们的处境可能比当初直接留在美国要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: Canada says the number of asylum seekers crossing from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 加拿大表示，从美国越境进入魁北克的寻求庇护者人数

sentences.en: to Quebec is unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 是史无前例的。

sentences.en: 3,000 in July and almost 4,000 in just the first half of August, equaling around 250 people crossing every day.
sentences.zh: 7月份有3000人，8月上半月就有近4000人，相当于每天有约250人越境。

sentences.en: And not only that, the Canadian immigration system is being stretched to a near breaking point.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，加拿大的移民系统正处于崩溃边缘。

sentences.en: And there is a backlog of some 40,000 asylum cases and not enough judges to adjudicate.
sentences.zh: 目前积压了约4万起庇护案件，且没有足够的法官进行裁决。

sentences.en: So the process can drag on for as long as two years.
sentences.zh: 所以这个过程可能会拖上两年之久。

sentences.en: Wow, two years of just waiting to figure out whether you'll get asylum.
sentences.zh: 哇，要等两年才能知道是否能获得庇护。

sentences.en: But all along, they are getting the benefits that you described.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，他们一直在享受你所描述的福利。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The surprising thing is that the system is under so much strain that the Canadian government is even resorting to sending members of Justin Trudeau's Liberal Party, themselves,
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，系统承受了如此大的压力，以至于加拿大政府甚至不得不派遣贾斯汀·特鲁多自由党的成员，他们本身就是

sentences.en: former refugees or immigrants, to the United States to warn would-be immigrants not to come and to emphasize the point that the country may not be the promised land
sentences.zh: 前难民或移民，前往美国警告潜在的移民不要过来，并强调这个国家可能并非这些移民所期望的应许之地。

sentences.en: that these immigrants expect.
sentences.zh: 加拿大正在派遣那些受益于加拿大开放移民系统的前移民，去世界各地劝阻未来的移民不要来加拿大。

sentences.en: Canada is sending former immigrants who benefited from Canada's open immigration system out into the world to dissuade future migrants from coming to Canada.
sentences.zh: 这真是太引人注目了。

sentences.en: That's kind of remarkable.
sentences.zh: 确实非常引人注目。

sentences.en: It is quite remarkable.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常引人注目。

sentences.en: So, for example, earlier this month,
